question: Identify customers who belong to the 'SME' segment and had total consumption in 2012 exceeding 40,000. For these customers, calculate the average price per unit (total price divided by total amount) across all their transactions that occurred at gas stations in the Czech Republic (Country = 'CZE') during 2012. Return the customer ID, total 2012 consumption, number of CZE transactions, and the average price per unit, sorted by total consumption descending.

prediction.sql:
WITH customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.XCL_001 AS customer_id,
        SUM(ym.XCL_021) AS total_2012_consumption
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'SME'
      AND SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001
    HAVING SUM(ym.XCL_021) > 40000
)
SELECT
    cc.customer_id,
    cc.total_2012_consumption,
    COUNT(t.XCL_010) AS num_cze_transactions,
    CAST(SUM(t.XCL_018) AS REAL) / SUM(t.XCL_017) AS avg_price_per_unit
FROM customer_consumption cc
INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON cc.customer_id = t.XCL_013
INNER JOIN gasstations g ON t.XCL_015 = g.XCL_004
WHERE g.XCL_006 = 'CZE'
  AND SUBSTRING(t.XCL_011, 1, 4) = '2012'
GROUP BY cc.customer_id, cc.total_2012_consumption
ORDER BY cc.total_2012_consumption DESC
